# Independent shared-source review: private offers, inspected hand and dying suits

Reviewer: `/root/chen_lin_close`. Integration base: `4fbb20200bcbe5d38d3c57e63d6921a07813093d`; author source baseline: `f373ef47ff50f735bed91cf74a2bc0d2c622d2a7`. No remaining definite issue was identified in the seven named final shared source files. This is source review and exact byte verification. Compilation, production-loader acceptance and runtime behavior remain unverified.

All seven raw before files and final previews match the refreshed combined-preview-map. Their before bytes match the exact current-base Git blobs after BOM/CRLF normalization. All complete root unified diffs were independently rebuilt using universal line splitting and LF terminators. The existing ProgramLifecycle before contains one CRCRLF which the final preview represents as two CRLF; universal line splitting preserves the same blank line and matches the root diff exactly. The historical source-baseline archive was separately checked against f373 and was never used as the current before. byte-verification.json records every exact path, SHA and proof. OL Yi Ji's current EventTarget branch is retained verbatim; the other six pairs retain their already reviewed hashes.

## Private offers and turn holds

Hold identity and snapshot additions are optional. Existing non-offer holds retain their old lifetime, owner and return behavior. Deferred offers stay physically source-owned while projecting the logical private-pile owner as the target. Exact due-frame prompt validation permits target visibility only in the authorized payment prompt; the source retains its own knowledge. All old DeferredCards visibility providers and final entity de-duplication remain. Death cleanup covers the physical source or logical target, while ordinary holds retain the prior cleanup.

CanRunProgramTrigger's deferred resolver exception follows owner-seat validation and is limited by the captured original due identity, lifecycle parent/continuation, source/candidate cursor, locations and issued receipt. It permits the issued obligation to survive source skill loss without broadening unrelated candidate guards. ResumeAfterDeferredPrivateOffers pops its own lifecycle frame and resumes the actual turn continuation; handled ledger entries prevent repeat payment. Explicit NormalTurnStart zero preserves the mature continuation enum values.

## Three capabilities and original parents

PrivateOffer, InspectedHand and DyingSuits predicates are bool terms in damageProgramDying. coreDecision remains exactly the original nullable RequestedDeckBasicInvariantDecision expression. The three capabilities add typed proofs and named action/AI dispatch while preserving existing branches. Actual payment producers, original parent IDs, source identities, frozen candidate cursors and typed child returns remain owning-frame authority.

The 112 original-Dying suspension filter is limited to its continuous authorized paid subtree and retains the older OwnedDeathBenefit filter. Its pure helper path was read with actual judgment, movement, HP, random-equipment and recovery helpers and does not recursively consult ActiveDying. The changed ProgramSkill-Dying invariant selects active Dying or the exact new suspended original, retaining producer adjacency and DamageFrameId checks. A suspended 112 original does not revoke 111/113 issued receipts: authorized paid descendants retain local actual-child proofs. No unrelated hidden old Dying token enters the new guard.

Attack/use completion reads captured finishing state and typed return ownership. Historical FireAttack returns at actual attack completion; the already-popped completed CardUse defers its whole return using its captured active-attack flag. Multi-Duel with an inactive retained prior attack and last-target skip/nullification returns directly. Inspected-hand zero-Slash uses its own captured parent and is excluded from generic selected-parent rewriting. These paths preserve one whole-use return before a next historical slot.

## Concurrent and absent-capability behavior

RuleQueries adds only inspected-hand distance around the existing HP-ordered calculation. Current Boundary Zhou Tai contributions, Boundary Cao Ren/hand-limit paths and all remaining query source are retained verbatim. The 4fbb lifecycle preview retains OL Yi Ji EventTarget handling for DyingEntering, CardsMoved, CardsGained and DiscardPileReceived, including its living-seat condition. New candidate gates apply only to their named effects. With no issued new receipt, the added filters return the previous result and optional checkpoint fields are omitted when null. These seven previews change no version source.

## Separate root correction and validation limit

The original SP Cai Wen Ji frozen fixture has a known AttackRange/add/8 descriptor error. Root separately corrected that test recipe to unlimited without amount and corrected exact paid-discard classification, preserving frozen author bytes. Both narrow revisions are independently recorded in chen-lin-review-cai-wen-ji/root-revision-verification.json and its REVIEW addendum. They lie outside this seven-file production verdict. All eight draft outcomes remain unexecuted.

Compiler/build/productionLoader/focusedTests/routineTests/fullTests/Core/WPF/game/nativeAi/UI/benchmark/release/publish/commit/push/HTTP/generator execution flags are all false. Test timing is null. Only source, JSON, hash and Git reads and finite text/hash Python operations were used. No author stage, root preview, tracked main file, index or branch was written. Only this owned ignored review directory contains minimal retained deliverables. Previously blocked cleanup was not retried.

# Final shared Core source review

This review covers the eleven assigned shared Core files in the root's combined preview map: CardMovementPrograms, CardUseModules, GameEngine.ActualPlayPhaseCardUses, GameEngine.CardMovementPrograms, GameEngine.DamageColorDuelPrograms, GameEngine.ProgramDiscardTopPlacement, Projection/CommittedEventProjection, Resolution, SkillProgramDependencies, SkillProgramExecutor and SkillPrograms. The final review manifest names the exact base, paths and raw before/after hashes. Author drafts retain their original f373 baseline and frozen hashes. The root's revision files are separate inputs.

The current integration base is `4fbb20200bcbe5d38d3c57e63d6921a07813093d`. An initial before-hash check caught the concurrent Yi Ji commit advancing the former 1394 base; no stale before file was accepted. Root rebuilt its merge and diffs. The final two affected files preserve GiveDrawPileBottomCard=7160, PerOwnerSourceHandGain=763, the cardsMoved window validation and all three owner-source hand-gain collection/context hooks. The other nine assigned final files are unchanged by that remerge.

The review is source reading and bounded source/hash arithmetic only. No C# compilation, production loader, test, game, replay, native AI, WPF/UI, benchmark, HTTP, release, publish or push was executed. Neither this reviewer nor its helpers changed main files, Git index, branches, frozen author files, combined preview bytes or old worktrees. No runtime acceptance is claimed.

## Shared behavior and preservation

- SkillPrograms keeps all pre-existing effect enum values and introduces explicit 7700/7701/7702, 7800, 7900/7901 values without renumbering the older operations. Cao Ren's 7150/7151 remain present. The unique-rank Dying operation and current boundary:buqu-current recipe remain intact. New composition calls act only on their matching operations; unrelated recipes retain their former gates. Private-offer deposit/due pairing, zero-card active hand/HP selection, standalone once-per-Play hand inspection, exact round Any Dying and own Ending history recipes have distinct checks. Versions are unchanged by these additions.
- Resolution adds optional frame-owned receipts and immutable scalar return identities rather than an external pending ledger. Collection-bearing Dying original cursors, discard receipts, historical slots, game-target card/location lists and inspected-hand viewed lists clone at constructor/init boundaries, including with/JSON assignment. Private-offer due locations use an explicit cloning setter. The new collection-bearing discard fact receives committed projection cloning; all older projection arms remain. These are source guarantees, not executed mutation or replay checks.
- ActualPlayPhaseCardUses calls the new history recorder before existing hooks. The recorder requires content opt-in, genuine Use, actual own Play and eligible Basic/InstantTrick identity. It returns before publishing when that capability is absent, preserving the older no-cap event sequence. Existing actual-use tracking is retained separately. The round dependency adds only the matching 7900 trigger while keeping previous tiered/dynamic/refund/pile-Alcohol/ending triggers.
- CardMovementPrograms and GameEngine.CardMovementPrograms add a specific historical one-Hand payment return. Admission requires the exact owning CardUse, live typed return, undrained cost and matching instruction frame; eligible batches keep that owner and have no unrelated awaiting Program frame. The completed movement window validates the same parent before continuing payment. Existing declaration, recovery, draw, counterspell, pile-Alcohol, equipment and faction returns remain. The new branch does not admit arbitrary stack frames or ordinary cleanup as payment.
- GameEngine.DamageColorDuelPrograms represents a zero-material Peach only when the exact issued DyingSuits typed return validates. Existing tiered and zero Duel branches and ordinary physical processing lookup remain. Whole historical return uses the actual completed CardUse.CardAttack.Active owner: real FireAttack attack tails defer, an inactive retained first Duel attack does not suppress a final skipped/nullified whole-use return, and mature group/simple/multi-Slash producers retain their own tail order. The related new/final API references were read as dependencies; this review does not replace runtime validation of those producers.
- CardUseModules integrates inspected-hand distance grants into the same ordered actual-turn expiration and global grant-sequence invariant. With that list empty, the older expiration output is unchanged. Existing modifiers, target policies and grant stores remain present. Current Cao Ren and Zhou Tai paths are preserved while the added provenance recognition permits Chenqing's real discard to reach discard-only observers, including the existing current Fenji source path.

## Resolved findings

1. The frozen fixture's multi binding used attackRange/add/amount8, which the existing GrantTurnRuleModifier descriptor rejects. The root revision replaces it with attackRange/unlimited and removes amount; the mature parser and invariant are unchanged. The revised fixture retains eight methods and the independently source-derived fixed seed31 shuffle layout. Its actual acceptance remains unexecuted.
2. Chenqing's actual HE discard used the suffix .DrawThenDiscardSuitsForDyingPeach.discard, but the earlier skill-program whitelist extracted only the last token and rejected its provenance. The root preview now recognizes exactly that paid operation suffix inside the existing skill-program prefix branch. The old operation whitelist and draw/use cleanup/death/recast exclusions remain. The revised existing composition method adds one positive and four negative reason assertions; no runner method was added.

The review manifest records both original and final hashes for these corrections. No other definite source issue remains in the assigned shared scope at the named final inputs. Broader card combinations, runtime observer execution, cold checkpoint restore, actual AI behavior, test fixture acceptance and timing still require the deferred verification run.

# Batch 37 shared Core review: inspected-hand reviewer

Decision: no deterministic remaining issue identified in the seven assigned shared files. This is a source review of the final three-author mixed preview, with the current raw main files as its before bytes. It is not compilation, test execution, game execution, or full-repository acceptance.

Base HEAD: `4fbb20200bcbe5d38d3c57e63d6921a07813093d`. Original review HEAD was `1394b09f1fa76a766c6baa1694a9a415c6c2800f`; all seven raw-before and raw-after pairs remain identical after the rebase. The six changed combined inputs are outside this assigned scope and are recorded in `root-integration/preview-rebase-4fbb.json`. Author source baseline: `f373ef47ff50f735bed91cf74a2bc0d2c622d2a7`. The author baseline was not substituted for current main raw-before bytes. All seven current-main and preview raw SHA-256 values were recomputed and matched `root-integration/combined-preview-map.json`; its captured SHA-256 is `af493f0a1f7a186b49e05d7c8405879a860e64413ad0da2775a0bd8239f43665`.

| Shared input | Reviewed integration effect |
| --- | --- |
| `GameEngine.SkillPrograms.cs` | Activation gates, exact new movement return predicates, new receipt assertions, nested-damage permission and original ProgramSkill Dying parent guard. |
| `GameEngine.HpChangePrograms.cs` | Original Dying entry ownership/cursor, actual HP-change continuation and historical cost-child return. |
| `HpChangePrograms.cs` | Additive explicit `HistoricalEndingCardUse = 7901` continuation; existing numeric values retain their assignments. |
| `GameEngine.Runtime.cs` | Exact new receipt dispatch and movement return before generic source checks; retained legacy death-benefit dispatch/completion. |
| `GameEngine.CardUseLifecycle.cs` | Real zero-material Chenqing Peach handling after finalized programs and before physical-card lookup. |
| `GameEngine.CardAttackState.cs` | Historical/inspected-hand typed completion receipts captured from the actual owning CardUseFrame, with existing receipt fields preserved. |
| `GameEngine.CardActions.cs` | Own-Play history appearance capture and mature completed-attack return ordering. |

Original HP/Damage Dying: `GameEngine.SkillPrograms.cs:1291` now validates every active ProgramSkill Dying and the exact original token suspended by Chenqing. The original guard still requires its immediately preceding ProgramSkill parent, matching parent ID and null DamageFrameId. `GameEngine.HpChangePrograms.cs:173` keeps the immediately preceding original Dying, exact ResumeDyingFrameId, entry continuation/candidate bounds and original victim; it no longer obtains the original victim from the possibly nested ActiveDying. The supporting pure Chenqing cursor/prefix proof checks parent adjacency and hashes, the original Dying responder/entry cursor, and, for Damage, the actual adjacent DamageFrame and original attack owner. It does not recurse through ActiveDying.

The 111 paid HP receipt and 113 private HP-loss receipt remain valid while Chenqing hides that exact original living Dying. The original ProgramSkill guard still executes. The private offer's observer helper can stop matching during the suspension because it asks for ActiveDying, but its all-owner invoice assertion uses the immutable private offer receipt, not that observer helper. Thus the observer lookup does not itself reject the frozen original 113 parent. The 111 HP stage likewise validates immutable payment facts rather than requiring its original Dying to stay globally active.

Legacy OwnedDeathBenefit: the existing `TryAdvanceOwnedDeathBenefitSubtree` dispatch follows the new Chenqing dispatch at Runtime 363-364. With no Chenqing receipt, the new dispatch returns false. `FinishOwnedDeathBenefitReturn` at Runtime 507 remains before the same program pop and binding-resolved fact. `TryReturnPairBenefitMovement` remains in the old movement-return path. The legacy structural return/filter helpers were read as supporting source and were not modified by these seven previews. Original dead-Dying handling and its established receipt validation were not replaced with the new living-Dying mechanism.

Already-paid children: each new Runtime resume/return hook selects its own frame-owned receipt. Historical Hand-to-Processing payment is issued once before the child drain; HP-change and movement returns resume the same CardUseFrame while `EndingHistoricalCostDrained` is false, and only then mark it true and start the producer. The corresponding HP continuation assertion requires the exact resume/parent frame. New paid movement return hooks precede the existing generic source/skill qualification cancellation. 111 HP/foreign-discard, 112 draw/discard/Peach and 113 deposit/exchange/remove-HP supporting state transitions do not re-enter their unpaid cost issuance after a paid child returns. Their mature recovery, HP, movement and Dying children drain before the next decision or final return.

Whole Ending Use: supporting mixed `GameEngine.cs:13173` advances sequential trick targets before `CaptureAttackCompletion`; Fangtian advances all remaining targets before that same capture. `GameEngine.CardActions.cs:496` captures the receipt before popping the completed actual Use and invokes the attack completion afterward. Supporting `GameEngine.cs:13847` pops only the complete original frame, then invokes the typed returns. The historical return also requires the original Use to be absent, one matching CardUseFinishedEvent and no previous historical return before advancing its slot.

The supporting historical return's frozen Active bit avoids the FireAttack double-return: an actual attack owner defers the pop-hook return to its captured completion. A multiple-target Duel whose last target is nullified retains an inactive earlier attack; the final normal trick pop returns that whole original Use once. BorrowedSword creates a separate nested Slash Use with no copied historical return and returns that Slash to the original BorrowedSword producer; adjusted pairs continue before the original trick's final finish/pop. Fangtian's ordered owner finishes every target before emitting the final attack receipt. No first target or nested Slash completion advances the Moshi slot.

No-capability branches: the new own-Play tracker is gated by the catalog's historical-use operation. Receipt assertions return immediately for unrelated frames, the Chenqing subtree dispatcher has no root without its receipt, the Peach continuation returns false without its typed receipt, and the new private/hand/Ending resume hooks return false on unrelated owners. Existing Runtime handler order and existing fallback movement/payment logic are retained. The added fields on the private in-memory AttackCompletionReceipt are null when those uses are absent; existing receipt selection remains unchanged.

Outside assigned scope, root revision addendum: the frozen 112 fixture's unsupported `attackRange/add/amount8` was corrected in a root-owned revision; original author bytes remain frozen at SHA `66abd5455a59d5f6ce7541b62761e579ad78f42a2b973b3ff28663f6d0ecc245`. The adopted test revision was rehashed to `6b65678d76ba4eebb614621dcf1bd790e58842bad0d45c8d2c61890e5810f4ff`. Its raw source diff has only two changes: `attackRange/unlimited` with no amount, and five paid-discard classification assertions inside the existing contract method. The modifier now agrees with `ProgramLifecycleOperationDefinitions.cs:480-486` and `CardUseModules.cs:701`. `GameEngine.IsDiscardMovementReason` is an existing internal static API with the Core.Tests friend assembly declared in `AssemblyInfo.cs:3`; no new runner or framework is used.

The corresponding root-owned `GameEngine.ProgramDiscardTopPlacement.cs` preview was rehashed to `818bfc90eb63ae5645137b3d030e7c4b90d807ac864d4b13d1ede102e0a9bb22`. Its exact new `.DrawThenDiscardSuitsForDyingPeach.discard` suffix is accepted only inside the existing `skill-program.` reason branch. The established operation whitelist and unrelated fallbacks remain in place. The real Chenqing paid-discard reason matches; the draw reason, unknown skill-program discard suffix, use-finished cleanup and recast remain excluded. The five added test literals directly name those classifications. This addendum found no deterministic remaining issue in the two root revisions, but neither the parser nor the tests were executed. No batch-wide approval follows from this subset report.

Limitations: this report covers only the named seven shared inputs and supporting call paths read to assess their integration. It does not approve every other shared file, every author file, or runtime fixture acceptance. C# compile/build, production loader, focused/full tests, game/native AI/UI execution, seed search, network, benchmark, release/publish/push, main source/index/branch writes and commits were all false for this reviewer. Only source/data/hash reads and this owned report were written.
